Before the delivery of process equipment, appropriate facilities must be constructed at the site for secure storage. Manufacturing of the equipment will be done at the vendor's premises. Inspection of the manufactured items shall be done at the vendor’s premises by Cliffs Burns Harbor or by an appointed agency by Cliffs Burns Harbor upon getting an inspection call from the vendor. The manufactured items are then packed and shipped. On arrival of the items at the proposed Plant premises, the packages will be opened and shall again be inspected for outward damages and completeness. 2.8 Equipment Erection The erection of equipment for the plant facilities will commence after the availability of civil and structural fronts, as well as receipt of the equipment at the site to match the sequence of erection. The installation of power, water and utility systems will also be taken up simultaneously. Order for equipment erection will be placed on shortlisted resourceful and experienced contractors as far as possible to ensure the quality of the job and completion of work as scheduled. Erection of the equipment for different plant facilities shall be completed sequentially to match the commissioning schedule of the plant. A typical methodology has been given before for a critical erection of the Absorber Contactor Vessel. 2.9 Trial Run and Commissioning On completion of the equipment erection and availability of utilities, trial runs of the individual items shall have to be taken up under the guidance of the experts of the equipment manufacturer. The trial run and commissioning will include a cold commissioning and a hot run, followed by performance guarantee tests (PGT). Commercial production shall start after the completion of all commissioning activities. 2.10 Possible Mode of Implementation The modes of the implementation strategy to be adopted for the execution of the project is to be developed based on the following primary considerations: a) Volume and location of construction work. b) Quantum of jobs available from other ongoing/planned projects with prospective suppliers and executing agencies during the actual awarding of various packages. c) Availability of qualified equipment suppliers. d) Availability of appropriate agencies for civil, structural, and equipment erection work. e) Availability of skilled and unskilled labor. f) Time frame for various works units within the overall project schedule.
